subject: EdgeHarbor temporary subprocessor swap — evidence + DPA addendum request
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Ford <samantha.ford@brightbank.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: EdgeHarbor temporary subprocessor swap — evidence + DPA addendum request

Hi Samantha —

Quick heads-up: we need to make a short-term subprocessor swap for the BrightBank production telemetry pipeline next week. The vendor is EdgeHarbor (EdgeHarbor, Inc.). This is a temporary arrangement (anticipated 6–8 weeks) while our primary telemetry relay undergoes an upgrade.

To keep BrightBank in the loop and satisfy your procurement/security checklist, I'm attaching: the EdgeHarbor onboarding packet, a preliminary dataflow diagram, and a draft DPA addendum that limits scope to telemetry and logs and includes an onshore routing clause.

Could you confirm the exact evidence items BrightBank needs for the security review? Typical asks we expect: SOC2 summary, encryption-at-rest/in-transit details, data residency routing, and export controls. If you want, I can schedule a 30-minute call with EdgeHarbor and our security team later today.

Next steps we propose from our side:
- Legal to sign the DPA addendum (draft attached) or provide redlines
- Security to provide the SOC2 summary and network topology
- Ops to set a safe cutover window with rollback plan and canary routing

Thanks — trying to keep this low-impact for you.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake | Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0194

Attachments: edgeharbor_onboard_packet.pdf; dataflow_diagram.drawio; dpa_addendum_draft.docx

From: Samantha Ford <samantha.ford@brightbank.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@brightbank.com
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:45:22 -0700
Subject: Re: EdgeHarbor temporary subprocessor swap — evidence + DPA addendum request

Jordan —

Thanks for the notice and for consolidating the docs. A few clarifications from BrightBank procurement/security: 

1) We need the specific SOC2 report (either the actual report or the auditor's summary sheet) for EdgeHarbor, not just a self-attestation. Can EdgeHarbor provide that?
2) Please confirm whether EdgeHarbor will ever receive unredacted customer PII. Our telemetry is tokenized but we require confirmation.
3) Outline exactly which regions EdgeHarbor will process data in (we require US-only for this tenant).
4) For the DPA addendum, the BrightBank legal team prefers tracked redlines. We can return redlines ASAP if you provide an editable doc.

We appreciate the canary plan — please include an explicit rollback SLA and a contact for incident escalation (phone + backup).

If you can get the SOC2 evidence and residency confirmation within 24 hours, procurement will consider an expedited approval pending Legal redline. Otherwise we may need a temporary block.

Best,
Samantha Ford
Sr. Procurement Manager, BrightBank
Samantha.Ford@brightbank.com

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Samantha Ford <samantha.ford@brightbank.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EdgeHarbor temporary subprocessor swap — evidence + DPA addendum request

Hi Samantha / Jordan —

Thanks for the quick feedback, Samantha. I spoke with the EdgeHarbor security lead this morning and can confirm the following (summary):

- SOC2: EdgeHarbor has a Type II SOC2 from auditor ClearGate. They can provide the auditor summary report under NDA. EdgeHarbor asked if BrightBank would accept the auditor summary sheet plus the SOC2 bridge letter; they will upload the full auditor report to an NDA-protected share if needed.
- PII: EdgeHarbor will only process tokenized telemetry for BrightBank. They confirm no raw PII will be persisted. We will provide their data retention matrix and redaction workflow as evidence.
- Residency: EdgeHarbor operates US-only processing for BrightBank's tenant (I confirmed region tags: us-west-2 and us-east-1). They have contractual commitments to route egress within US boundaries for this account.
- Escalation contacts: primary: Alex Rivera (alex.rivera@edgeharbor.com, +1 206-555-0133); backup: security_ops@edgeharbor.com.

I've attached the preliminary evidence we requested from EdgeHarbor. Per BrightBank's ask, EdgeHarbor is willing to provide the auditor summary via a protected share; we can coordinate an NDA if procurement/legal prefers.

Kimberly — can you (Legal) accept the docx DPA addendum and return tracked changes? Also tagging Ops for the cutover window and rollback SLA — Jordan, can you confirm proposed maintenance windows?

Best,
Irene Choi
Principal, Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: edgeharbor_onboard_packet.pdf (includes bridge letter), dataflow_diagram.drawio

Thanks, Irene and Samantha.

Action items I'm committing to right now: 
- I will arrange the NDA-protected transfer of the EdgeHarbor SOC2 auditor summary and bridge letter to BrightBank by EOD today. (DocuSign link for the NDA is in the HubSpot record; I will share once completed.)
- Kimberly, please review the attached DPA addendum and return tracked redlines by Monday EOD (BRB-ACCT-2219 legal thread).
- Ops will propose a 2-hour maintenance window next Wednesday 03:00–05:00 UTC for a canary cutover; rollback criteria and SLA will be included in the runbook. Irene / Ops to confirm.

Samantha — assuming the SOC2 summary + residency confirmation go through, is procurement comfortable with an expedited approval pending legal redline? If yes, we will queue the cutover and start the routing change in canary first.

Appreciate the partnership here — we'll be conservative on rollout and provide daily status updates until the primary relay is back in service.

—Jordan
